verdict.rationale: cubic documents its own noise-reduction features. Thumbs up/down reactions calibrate 'what's useful vs noise', replies teach it what to do differently, and it learns from senior engineers' past reviews. Datadog logs can confirm findings to cut false positives, threads auto-resolve once fixed, and cubic.yaml supports ignore patterns. The deduplication and severity-labeling parts of the story have no evidence, and nothing independent shows low false-positive rates. Missing for 10: severity labels on comments, deduplication of comments, independent or hands-on evidence of low false-positive rates.
